senses.sense_definition: stijf of gevoelloos worden door hevige koude; bevangen worden door de kou

examples.text: Zonder handschoenen <w>verkleumden</w> haar vingers al na een kwartier in de ijzige wind.

target_lang_translations.en: Without gloves, her fingers <w>went numb with cold</w> after just fifteen minutes in the icy wind.

examples.text: We stonden zo lang op de bus te wachten dat we helemaal <w>verkleumden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: We were waiting for the bus for so long that we were completely <w>chilled to the bone</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: to become numb, stiff, or chilled to the bone due to severe cold

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to lose sensation or mobility from severe cold
to feel extremely cold or chilled

en.target_lang_word: to be chilled to the bone
en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to be thoroughly and deeply cold
